job.value: compare listings of one card and judge the going price

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: Query, '3 results in Singapore' and the listing grid make it a results page.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: Listing cards dominate, with the 'See prices for Mega Gengar ex 230/19... S$34 Prices are falling >' row directly above them.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'All categories' and 'Filters' are clear, but the 'Delivery' chip carries a shield icon that suggests protection rather than delivery.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'JP' / 'EN' tags are known to TCG buyers, but 'Good Deal' and 'Prices are falling' don't say what they're measured against.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Only filters and taps a browsing buyer can make.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Price history is behind the 'See prices' row; cards stay short.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything serves a buyer comparing card listings.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Prices, strikethrough price and the 'Prices are falling' signal carry it with no paragraph.
